title: Tool Templates
description: Allows you to combine armor trims with your tools and weapons letting you not add trims to your tools but change the way your tools are shaped.
body:
This mod allows you to combine the already ingame armor trims into tool templates that make your tools and weapons look more unique giving more personality to the game and customization.
Future Trims will include the ability to add color trims to each weapon expanding even more customization.
